commands.command:
set -eu
echo CURRENT_JAVA=$(command -v java || true)
java -version 2>&1 || true
echo JAVA_HOME_TOOL
/usr/libexec/java_home -V 2>&1 || true
echo JDK_DIRS
ls -la /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines 2>/dev/null || true
ls -la "$HOME/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines" 2>/dev/null || true
echo HOMEBREW_OPENJDK
ls -d /opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk* 2>/dev/null || true
for v in 21 21.0 21.0.1 21.0.2; do /usr/libexec/java_home -v "$v" 2>/dev/null && break || true; done
